risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate upward trend (a net rise of ~13% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.084), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single NaiveMovingAverage' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.0156. Series context: trend strength 0.3127 and seasonal strength 0.9551; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.084); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.346.
